name: Skyship Plunderer
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, for each kind of counter on target permanent or player, give that permanent or player another counter of that kind.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, for each kind of counter on target permanent or player, give that permanent or player another counter of that kind.

needs.what: an op that, for ONE targeted permanent or player (a single target spec accepting either a permanent or a player), puts one more counter of each kind already on it -- +1 of every counter kind present on a permanent, or +1 poison/energy/experience etc. on a player
needs.why_existing_wont_do: proliferate takes only `as` and is untargeted, letting the controller choose any number of permanents and players, which is a different (broader) effect; add_counters needs one named `counter` kind and cannot iterate over the kinds present; for_each iterates objects, not counter kinds; double_counters/double_player_counters double every count rather than adding one of each kind
